content.bridge_context: Categorizing everyday substances based on their chemical nature.

units.title: Taste and Nature
units.explanation: Acids are sour (like lemon). Bases are bitter and soapy (like soap).
units.dual_language_instruction: Mention a sour food item. / एक खट्टे खाद्य पदार्थ का नाम बताएं।

units.title: Indicators
units.explanation: Substances that change color to show if something is acidic or basic. Example: Litmus, Turmeric.
units.dual_language_instruction: What color does turmeric turn with soap? / साबुन के साथ हल्दी का रंग क्या हो जाता है?
